summary: CDP transport fails instead of silently picking the first ignitionapp.com tab when multiple Ignition origins are open; IGNITION_CDP_TAB_MATCH pins a specific workspace tab by URL substring.
reason: Greptile PR #1528 P1 security: the tab loop chose the first page whose URL contained ignitionapp.com without checking the origin, so with tabs from different Ignition origins open, a command could run in the wrong authenticated workspace and return another firm's data. Same-origin tabs share one browser session (same workspace) so any is fine; distinct origins now error. Hand-authored novel internal/cdp package (patch 0003 lineage).
validated_outcome: New TestTabOriginDistinguishesWorkspaces covers subdomain/scheme distinctness, same-origin collapse, and garbage-URL non-merge; live CDP pipeline read still returns the real proposal book. go test ./internal/cdp green.
